subject: MAP launch playbook — draft milestones & stakeholder confirmation
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearsight.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: MAP launch playbook — draft milestones & stakeholder confirmation

Alex — thanks again for the discovery earlier. Per our call, attached is an initial Mutual Action Playbook that translates the items we discussed into milestones, owners, and dependencies. Key asks here: please confirm the stakeholder list and a target close window (we proposed 12/20/2026), and flag any dependencies you think are underestimated.

High-level milestones (see attached for details):
- Week 1: sandbox access + data sample exchange — owner: ClearSight (Claire)
- Week 2: ingest & baseline tests — owner: Redwood (Marissa)
- Week 3–4: performance tuning & quantization validation — owner: Redwood (Engineering)
- Week 5: UAT + security sign-off — owner: ClearSight (Alex)
- Delivery: production rollout plan + handoff — owner: joint

Dependencies called out: VPC peering / secure S3 access, SOC2 evidence for data handling, and a test dataset with 10k representative rows. If the VPC timeline slips, we recommend shipping a temporary token-based sandbox to keep momentum.

Please review the attached RDW_MAP_playbook_draft_v1.pdf and the Scope_and_dependency_matrix.xlsx. Can you confirm: 1) stakeholder names and emails for ownership, 2) if 12/20/2026 is a reasonable close target, and 3) whether there are procurement or legal steps we should add to the milestones?

Thanks — I'll incorporate your changes and share a second draft with explicit canary rollout dates.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: RDW_MAP_playbook_draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Scope_and_dependency_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearsight.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Ngyuen <claire.nguyen@clearsight.io>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP launch playbook — draft milestones & stakeholder confirmation

Thanks Grace — good write-up and the milestone sequence looks sensible. A few quick notes: 
1) Stakeholders: Claire will own sandbox access (as you noted). Add myself and our Head of ML Ops (Tom Riley, tom.riley@clearsight.io) for the UAT/security sign-off steps.
2) Close target: 12/20 is optimistic given our internal procurement window; can we plan for 01/10/2027 as a conservative target and work toward 12/20 if procurement clears early?
3) Dependencies: procurement will require a standard security questionnaire and our procurement lead will need the draft SOW to start legal review. Can you attach a short SOW draft or template we can route to legal/procurement?

Also, can we add an explicit milestone for performance SLOs validation (p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token requests) — Tom will want that spelled out.

I'll confirm Tom's availability for the kickoff next week once I sync internally.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Sr. Product Manager, ClearSight Analytics
alex.turner@clearsight.io

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -0500
Subject: MAP playbook v1.1 + SOW template attached — please confirm stakeholders & timeline

Alex / Tom / Claire — thanks for the quick feedback. I attached an updated playbook (v1.1) that: 
- moves target close to 01/10/2027 as a conservative option, with a fallback early-close path of 12/20/2026 if procurement completes earlier,
- inserts an explicit milestone for SLO validation (p95 latency target added),
- includes a short SOW template that procurement can begin routing.

Marissa — can you own the performance tuning milestone (Week 3–4) and coordinate with Jasmine on quantization validation? Jasmine, please confirm the estimated engineering effort (FTE-weeks) in the sheet so we can surface that in the SOW.

Alex — if Tom or procurement want additional artifacts, point me to what they need and I’ll prioritize. Once stakeholders confirm, I’ll lock the dates and send a calendar invite for a MAP kickoff working session (30–45m).

Thanks,
Grace

Attachments: RDW_MAP_playbook_draft_v1.1.pdf, Redwood_SOW_template.docx
